name: maintenance
description: Appwrite Function: three HTTP/database triggers - Google Sign-In (verifies a Credential Manager ID token and mints an Appwrite custom-token session, bypassing Appwrite's hosted OAuth2 pages entirely), the caller's own account deletion cascade, and syncing a list's task permissions to its current membership - merged into one function to fit the Appwrite Cloud free-tier limit of 2 functions per project. Ported from functions/src/accountDeletion.ts's deleteAccount, plus the new syncListPermissions and googleSignIn (see their own file comments).
